text:
priya: raising an idea: separate eviction logic into hot-tier and cold-tier pipelines. hot-tier prefixes keep strict residency guarantees + soft-pin, cold-tier uses aggressive shared eviction. goal: reduce unnecessary rehydrates for read-heavy hot prefixes.
nikhil: sounds promising. how do we classify hot vs cold? ttl-based? access-rate?
june: propose a 2-factor score: recent_qps and miss_cost_estimate. score > hot_threshold -> hot-tier. hot_threshold tunable per-tenant.
rachel: important: correctness constraints. hot-tier still uses exclusive ownership semantics today. cold-tier could permit best-effort shared residency across workers. we must ensure reads are still linearizable-ish for clients.
priya: explicit tradeoff: hot-tier keeps strong correctness (no shared read-from-other-worker path), cold-tier accepts eventual residency and may redirect reads to owner via a short RPC or accept stale-but-fast cache read with version check.
nikhil: implementation sketch: add prefix_attr.mode in metadata: "HOT" | "COLD_SHARED". eviction pipeline consults mode. HOT uses standard lease + eviction-credit. COLD_SHARED uses eviction_pool that allows multiple workers to temporarily pin shards with shared_refcount semantics.
june: shared_refcount semantics: workers ask for a soft_pin(token) from controller. controller grants soft_pin that doesn't block handoff; any worker holding soft_pin can serve reads but must attach pin_token to rehydrate ops so reassign detects them. on reassign, we drain soft_pins via best-effort invalidation + short grace.
rachel: what about writes / evictions in COLD_SHARED? writes must go through sequencer/owner. serve read-only from shared copies only if copy_freshness_ok(prefix.last_synced_ts). we should reject writes if not owner.
priya: freshness policy: allow shared copy reads if now - last_synced_ts < shared_read_fresh_ms (default 200ms). otherwise redirect to owner. introduce metric shared_read_stale_rejects.
nikhil: critical: avoid extra RPCs on hot path. fast path: local prefix.owner_id == local_worker -> normal code. cold-shared fast path: check soft_pin locally; cheap. only fallback does RPC.
june: handoff interplay: when orchestrator plans reassignment, it should proactively ask controller to revoke soft_pins and wait token_grace_ms before finalizing. if soft_pins persist past grace, increase demote_penalty and prefer draining traffic first.
rachel: tests: simulate workload with 100k prefixes with 5% hot, 10% warm, rest cold. measure p99 rehydrate latency and IO bytes saved. also test correctness: concurrent read-after-write on COLD_SHARED should observe write-through to owner and cause cache invalidation.
priya: metrics to add: shared_pins_active, shared_read_hit_rate, shared_read_stale_rejects, reassign_blocked_by_pins_count. dashboards for hot/cold separation by tenant.
nikhil: rollout: feature flag per-tenant. start with read-only workloads (embeddings) for cold-shared. enable for small tenants first. have auto-disable if shared_read_stale_rejects > 1% or reassign_blocked_by_pins_count > threshold.
june: corner-case: hot->cold flip flapping. solution: require min_hot_duration_ms (default 60s) before demoting to cold. likewise cold->hot should be conservative to avoid churn.
rachel: security: ensure pin_tokens are cryptographically random and expire; don't persist long-lived tokens to disk unless encrypted.
priya: API change: no external API changes — this is infra-only. but add admin toggle and per-tenant knobs in console.
nikhil: perf note: shared copies will increase memory usage but reduce IO. rough estimate: if 5% of prefixes become cold_shared across 10 workers, memory cost < 5% extra. good tradeoff for IO-bound workloads.
june: pseudocode for cold read fast-path:
```
if prefix.mode == COLD_SHARED and local.soft_pin.exists(prefix):
  if now - prefix.last_synced_ts <= shared_read_fresh_ms:
    return serve_from_local_copy()
  else:
    metric.inc("shared_read_stale_rejects")
    redirect_to_owner()
```
rachel: canary matrix: enable for embedding workloads -> logging apps -> general read-heavy tenants. ensure we throw out stale cached metrics during evaluation.
monitor-bot: note: I'll add alerts for shared_read_stale_rejects and reassign_blocked_by_pins_count.
priya: action items: Nikhil will prototype controller soft-pin API, June will add mode classification + scoring, Rachel will own correctness tests, I'll write rollout doc and knobs. meeting Friday to review prototype.
